title: My take on the Cabaret revival is the silence from the creatvie team/...
transcript: Cabaret is really about this Cabaret is really about that Alan Cumming/ Eddie Redmayne you know what the only take I really wanna hear about Cabaret right now? if you're doing a first class production of Cabaret particularly on Broadway particularly when tickets are like so expensive the price of some people's rent for two hours of time perhaps your cast and creative team has in my opinion a political obligation if they're making first class political art to acknowledge the political atrocities going on in the world particularly when those atrocities directly parallel the themes and story of their musical perhaps but we're not living in that reality
